integration_issues.issue: window.open() is called AFTER an async api.get(..., blob) await — in strict popup-block browsers this loses the user gesture and returns null, showing a 'Popup blocked — allow popups for this site' toast. In our Chromium test a tab was opened but 'win' was still null (blocked). Real users on Chrome with default settings may hit this intermittently. Suggest: open the tab window BEFORE the fetch (window.open('about:blank') synchronously, then set win.location = objectURL after the blob is ready), or serve payslip PDFs via a signed GET URL that can be opened directly.

integration_issues.issue: After browser reload the HR module lands on default Regulations tab (letter view is inside HR Module tab state, not URL-preserved). Not a functional bug — placement persistence was confirmed on the server (GET /api/hr/letters/{id} returned x=30, y=49.9, page=2). Just a navigation UX nit: consider syncing the active tab + open letter id into the URL so reloads preserve context.
